model_annotation: Figure 1 presents a bar chart illustrating the monthly calendar-adjusted base indices for manufactured pharmaceutical substances and products in Bulgaria for the years 2022, 2023, and 2024, with the base year set at 2021=100. The horizontal axis represents the months of the year, labeled from I to XII in sequence, while the vertical axis is labeled “/%” and displays values ranging from 0,000 to 140,000 in increments of 20,000, indicating the percentage deviation from the base index. The chart uses three distinct colors to represent each year: blue for 2022, orange for 2023, and gray for 2024. Each month on the horizontal axis has three adjacent bars, one for each year, stacked side by side. The bars are arranged in chronological order from January (I) to December (XII). There are no visual highlights or special markings on any of the bars.
